description: The company's Opportunities, as the dashboard's Analysis page shows them, read-only. `boats`: every published boat in the dashboard's order (the charted ones first, then by open weeks), with `open_weeks`, `vs_similar_pct` and `compare_url`, its public compare page. `vs_similar_pct` is how far the boat's weekly price sits over (positive) or under (negative) similar boats, as a median over the weeks it can be sold, each week against the median of the other operators' boats among up to 10 boats most like it of the same type in the same country, where at least 3 of them are priced (null: no week to compare). `price_suggestions`, up to five: `no_prices` (boats with no priced week in the next 12 months), `under` (a boat 15% or more under similar boats, with its widest week: `week`, `own`, `similar`), `over` (a run of two or more weeks 15% or more over them: `from`, `to` and the `own` and `similar` weekly ranges). `source_checks`, up to five: `feature` (kit sold as an extra but missing from the boats' equipment, so guests filtering for it do not see them), `photos` (boats with under half the photos similar boats have; `similar` is their median), `standout` (what Mermaid and the compare page tell guests a boat trails similar boats on). Figures are weekly totals in EUR, all in at max guests. Empty lists mean nothing to suggest.

company_id.description: Company id, from list_boats (`company_id`) or get_company.
